title: Ghost Signal
style: dreamy pop, buồn, feliz, uk hardcore
lyrics:
[BRIDGE]
They said "cut the frequency"
They said "drop the feed"
Said "nobody's listening to
someone who bleeds like that"
But I've been bleeding
in the key of every song
that saved a life at 3am
So tell me I'm wrong

Tell me the signal doesn't matter
Tell me the wave was never real
Tell me the ones who cracked the silence
Didn't change the way you feel

Go on —
Tell me.

[VERSE 3]
I picked up the pieces so many times
That picking up pieces started feeling like peace
Like maybe the breaking was part of the building
Like maybe the fractures let in what I need
I am not the wound
I am not the waiting
I am not the version
That the fear was creating
I am every note I played in empty rooms
Every word I stitched together from the ruins

Ghost in the signal —
But the signal's still broadcast
Ghost in the signal —
And the ghost ain't going back

[OUTRO CHORUS]
Ghost signal, ghost signal
Done bleeding through the noise
Ghost signal, ghost signal
Now I know the sound of my voice
Loud enough to shake the mountains
Strong enough to stay
Ghost signal lit and burning steady
I was always meant to break the silence
Always meant to say

[OUTRO — spoken]
Somewhere between the static and the silence
There's a frequency only the ones who survived can find.
Still transmitting.
AXIOM out.
Character count: ~3,100 — plenty of room if yo
